jobs.title: React Frontend Developer
jobs.description: We are looking for a skilled React Frontend Developer to build high-performance, reusable UI components and implement responsive web interfaces. The ideal candidate has 3+ years of experience with React, modern JavaScript, and state management libraries.
jobs.requirements: React.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5/CSS3, Redux or Context API, REST APIs, Git, responsive design, testing (Jest/RTL), Node.js knowledge is a plus

jobs.title: Python Developer
jobs.description: Seeking a Python Developer with experience in building scalable backend services, APIs, and data processing pipelines. The role involves working with cloud infrastructure and databases.
jobs.requirements: Python, Django/Flask, REST APIs, PostgreSQL/MongoDB, Docker, AWS/GCP, Git, CI/CD, data processing, problem-solving

jobs.title: ArcGIS Developer
jobs.description: Looking for an ArcGIS Developer to build geospatial applications, manage spatial databases, and create interactive mapping solutions using Esri ArcGIS platform.
jobs.requirements: ArcGIS, Python, JavaScript, spatial databases, GIS analysis, web mapping, ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, geocoding, cartography
